Subject: Next steps — private hosting technical deep-dive & ops slot

Hi Avery / Lina,

Thanks again for the call this morning — really helpful to hear more about MedSol's ingestion volumes and your compliance constraints. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock in the technical deep-dive focused on Private/VPC hosting: 

- Goal for the next call: validate network & identity requirements, review ops runbook, confirm initial sizing and a small POC timeline.
- Who we think should join: your infra lead (networking), a security contact (for KMS/HSM discussion), and our infra + CS (Connor + Rishi).

Proposed 60–75 minute slots (all in PT):
1) Monday 31 May — 10:00–11:15
2) Tuesday 1 June — 13:00–14:15
3) Wednesday 2 June — 09:30–10:45

Please reply with which slot works best or propose an alternate. I attached our short private-deploy checklist and a network-reqs spreadsheet to save time on the call. If you can, please share the names/emails for the MedSol attendees so we can include them in the calendar invite.

Prep items we’ll cover briefly at the start: network egress IPs, firewall rules, KMS key ownership model, and an ops runbook walkthrough.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this on the calendar.

Best,
Grace

--

Hi Avery / Lina,

Thanks — we’ll hold Mon 31 May 10:00–11:15 PT for the deep-dive. Quick answers to your asks below so you can share with security/network ahead of the call: 

- Outbound IPs: we publish a small egress pool for Private deployments. For your initial review, please white-list 34.201.112.0/24 and 34.201.113.0/24. We’ll provide the final list and ASN during the kickoff.
- KMS options: we support customer-managed KMS via AWS KMS integration (you supply key ARN and we reference it for envelope encryption), or Redwood-managed keys for teams that prefer us to operate keys. We'll walk through tradeoffs on Monday.

Agenda we’ll follow (30–40 min tech + 20–30 min ops/runbook + Q&A):
- Network topology & peering patterns
- KV cache persistence and PII controls
- KMS/HSM integration modes
- Runbook: upgrades, rollback, and incident ops

Connor (infra) and Rishi (SRE) will drive the demo/walkthrough. Grace will lead coordination.

See you Monday — I’ll send a calendar invite and include the short runbook link below.

Runbook (preview): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ExampleRunbookLink

Connor

--
Connor O'Brien
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
